eea_table: [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars] (Year=2021, MS='ES', Mk='TOYOTA', Cn='TOYOTA RAV4', Fm='H', Status='F')

evidence.source: IDAE Guía de consumo y emisiones — detalle vehículo id 540541 'Toyota RAV4 HYBRID 4x2 2.5 Advance Llanta 18p (MY21)' (POST https://coches.idae.es/ajax campo=detalle, fetched 2026-09-24)
evidence.what_it_shows: Official ES record for the exact commercial variant: 2.487 cm3, automático, MTMA 2.135, potencia 178,1 cv, potencia térmica 131,0 kW, WLTP 5,65 l/100 km, 128 g CO2/km, 4.600x1.855x1.685 mm, 5 plazas. It does NOT show any 'código de tipo/versión', TAN, Va or Ve (also checked Business 540540, 4x4 Advance 540546, NG19 478060: none carries a code). IDAE list shows separate 4x4 entries (e.g. 540546, MTMA 2.225).

evidence.source: EEA CO2 cars 2021 final (discodata), ES, TOYOTA RAV4, Fm='H', Status='F' (queried 2026-09-24)
evidence.what_it_shows: All ES 2021 RAV4 HEV rows have Ep=131 kW (matches IDAE 'potencia térmica 131 kW'); TAN families e6*2007/46*0289*02/*03/*04 (dominant *04) and e13*2007/46*1991*06/*07/*08 (small volumes); Va AXAH52, AXAL52, AXAH54, AXAL54; several Ve per Va (ANXMBW, ANXXBW, ANXGBW suffixes). Nothing in EEA names trim or drivetrain, so no official link from 'Advance 4x2' to one Va/Ve.

separate_technical_variants: Va AXAH52 vs AXAL52: both appear with M=1665 and Ep=131 in ES 2021 and are distinct type-approval variants; secondary parts catalogues associate '52' with FWD and '54' with AWD, and the H/L letter plausibly relates to battery type (Advance kept NiMH per Toyota ES press release 2020-09-03, Style/Luxury/Black Edition moved to Li-ion) — NOT verified by an official source, so neither may be chosen.
Va AXAH54 / AXAL54 (M 1710-1761 kg): presumably AWD-i 222 CV; must never be merged with the 4x2 even though Ep=131 kW is identical.
Ve suffixes ANXMBW / ANXXBW / ANXGBW (and revision tags 1C/2C/1D/2D/1E/2E) are separate versions with different mass/CO2 (e.g. ANXXBW 126-127 g/km vs ANXMBW 129 g/km); do not collapse.
TAN extensions *02, *03, *04 (e6, Belgium) and e13*2007/46*1991*06-*08 (Luxembourg) are separate approvals/revisions registered in ES in 2021.
missing_for_upgrade: An official document linking 'RAV4 220H 4x2 Advance MY21' to a TAN/Va/Ve: e.g. a CoC or ficha técnica (tarjeta ITV) of an ES Advance 4x2 unit showing TAN e6*2007/46*0289*0x, variant AXAH52(N) or AXAL52(N) and version string; or a Toyota ES/TME technical sheet listing model codes per trim. With TAN+Va from such a doc -> PARTIAL; with Ve too -> EXACT.
notes: IDAE (only official ES source with a detail page for this exact variant) carries no type/version code for Toyota, unlike the BYD SEAL example. Secondary sources seen (not evidence): amayama/partsouq parts catalogues describe AXAH52L-ANXMBW as EU-spec LHD A25A-FXS CVT; dauto.ch Typenschein lists AXAH52 FWD under e6*2007/46-2018/1832*0289. Toyota Europe HV dismantling manual (toyota-tech.eu 'RAV4_AXAH52,54 hvdm.pdf') would be an official manufacturer source for model-code->drivetrain but returned an HTML access page, not the PDF. EEA candidate values (Ep 131, M 1665, Ewltp 129) look like the car, but per brief that is UNCONFIRMED. Candidate list limited to '52' Va rows (e6 approvals); AWD '54' rows and e13 rows omitted from candidates by design.
